assumptions: This is a separately generated synthetic operating scenario, linked to existing DAI hospital IDs. It is not a count of the registered mother cohort and is not real hospital history.

The anchor's 25000 annual deliveries is a user-supplied configurable scenario assumption, not a claim about the imported hospital census. Other tier volumes, weekday effects, seasonality and stock balances are placeholders requiring partner validation.
All daily operating totals end at the configured as_of_date; this simulation assumes close-of-day totals. The clinical source ledger separately remains its original noon snapshot.
Synthetic booked-arrival counts are known 28 days in advance and are generated independently of realised delivery noise. Historical real-world booking snapshots are unavailable.
NICU counts forecast aggregate operational demand only. They do not predict or diagnose a particular baby's condition.
Stock units and consumption coefficients are inventory-planning assumptions, not medication doses or prescribing guidance. Scenario balances are not the hospital's recorded pharmacy stock.
Ranges use historical calibration residuals and are evaluated on a later untouched test period. Temporal dependence means nominal coverage is not guaranteed.
Clinical decisions, high-risk validation, reservations and purchasing remain with authorised humans. No automatic action is executed.
